question: Could you assess the relationship between the poverty rates from the previous year's census data and the percentage of births without maternal morbidity for the years 2016 to 2018? Use only data for births where no maternal morbidity was reported and for each year, use the 5-year census data from the year before to compute the Pearson correlation coefficient
sql:
WITH 
-- 2016: births without maternal morbidity, correlated with 2015_5yr census poverty
corr_2016 AS (
  SELECT 
    CORR(c.poverty_rate, SAFE_DIVIDE(n.births_no_morbidity, n.total_births)) AS pearson_corr
  FROM (
    SELECT County_of_Residence_FIPS,
           SUM(CASE WHEN Maternal_Morbidity_YN = 1 THEN Births ELSE 0 END) AS births_no_morbidity,
           SUM(Births) AS total_births
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.sdoh_cdc_wonder_natality.county_natality_by_maternal_morbidity`
    WHERE Year = '2016-01-01'
    GROUP BY County_of_Residence_FIPS
  ) n
  JOIN (
    SELECT geo_id, SAFE_DIVIDE(poverty, pop_determined_poverty_status) AS poverty_rate
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2015_5yr`
    WHERE pop_determined_poverty_status > 0
  ) c ON n.County_of_Residence_FIPS = c.geo_id
  WHERE c.poverty_rate IS NOT NULL AND SAFE_DIVIDE(n.births_no_morbidity, n.total_births) IS NOT NULL
),
-- 2017: births without maternal morbidity, correlated with 2016_5yr census poverty
corr_2017 AS (
  SELECT 
    CORR(c.poverty_rate, SAFE_DIVIDE(n.births_no_morbidity, n.total_births)) AS pearson_corr
  FROM (
    SELECT County_of_Residence_FIPS,
           SUM(CASE WHEN Maternal_Morbidity_YN = 1 THEN Births ELSE 0 END) AS births_no_morbidity,
           SUM(Births) AS total_births
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.sdoh_cdc_wonder_natality.county_natality_by_maternal_morbidity`
    WHERE Year = '2017-01-01'
    GROUP BY County_of_Residence_FIPS
  ) n
  JOIN (
    SELECT geo_id, SAFE_DIVIDE(poverty, pop_determined_poverty_status) AS poverty_rate
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2016_5yr`
    WHERE pop_determined_poverty_status > 0
  ) c ON n.County_of_Residence_FIPS = c.geo_id
  WHERE c.poverty_rate IS NOT NULL AND SAFE_DIVIDE(n.births_no_morbidity, n.total_births) IS NOT NULL
),
-- 2018: births without maternal morbidity, correlated with 2017_5yr census poverty
corr_2018 AS (
  SELECT 
    CORR(c.poverty_rate, SAFE_DIVIDE(n.births_no_morbidity, n.total_births)) AS pearson_corr
  FROM (
    SELECT County_of_Residence_FIPS,
           SUM(CASE WHEN Maternal_Morbidity_YN = 1 THEN Births ELSE 0 END) AS births_no_morbidity,
           SUM(Births) AS total_births
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.sdoh_cdc_wonder_natality.county_natality_by_maternal_morbidity`
    WHERE Year = '2018-01-01'
    GROUP BY County_of_Residence_FIPS
  ) n
  JOIN (
    SELECT geo_id, SAFE_DIVIDE(poverty, pop_determined_poverty_status) AS poverty_rate
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2017_5yr`
    WHERE pop_determined_poverty_status > 0
  ) c ON n.County_of_Residence_FIPS = c.geo_id
  WHERE c.poverty_rate IS NOT NULL AND SAFE_DIVIDE(n.births_no_morbidity, n.total_births) IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 2016 AS year, pearson_corr FROM corr_2016
UNION ALL
SELECT 2017, pearson_corr FROM corr_2017
UNION ALL
SELECT 2018, pearson_corr FROM corr_2018
